items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: Oh, I met Hugues Panassié in New York.

ctx.x: Yeah. How was your feeling towards Panassié?
Well, Hugues Panassié was a very wonderful person to me.
Uh-huh. Where did you first meet him?
Yeah. Right. We just listened to that tape, and it was Tommy Ladner on trumpet.
